chunks: As for what Aḥmad ibn Muḥammad ibn ʿĪsā narrated from ʿAbd Allāh ibn Abī Khalaf, from Yaḥyā ibn Hāshim, from Abū Hārūn al-ʿAbdī, from Abū Saʿīd al-Khudrī, who said:
When the Prophet صلى الله عليه وآله وسلم traveled one farsakh, he shortened the salat (prayer).

key_terms.الصَّلَاةَ: the salat (prayer), specifically the prescribed ritual prayer
key_terms.النَّبِيُّ: the Prophet صلى الله عليه وآله وسلم
key_terms.فَرْسَخًا: a farsakh; a unit of travel distance

ai.seo_question: At what travel distance did the Prophet صلى الله عليه وآله وسلم shorten the salat (prayer)?
ai.summary: This hadith reports that the Prophet صلى الله عليه وآله وسلم would shorten the salat (prayer) when traveling a farsakh. It is cited in the context of determining the legal distance at which qasr becomes applicable during travel.
